title: Treatment of Androgenetic Alopecia in Females, 9 Beam
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy of the HairMax LaserComb 2009 9 beam model in promoting hair growth in females diagnosed with androgenetic alopecia when treatment is applied as directed.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of androgenetic alopecia
* Fitzpatrick Skin Types I-IV
* Ludwig I-4, II-1, II-2, or frontal
* Active hair loss within last 12 months

Exclusion Criteria:

* Photosensitivity to laser light
* Malignancy in the target area
* Pregnancy
* Lactating females
